spans.text: Click.
...Right, got it.
Keep observing and wait for my instruction, Yegor.
Carter terminates the transmission.
Mastermind is lured out of her den. Should we act now?
Are you senile? How many times do I have to remind you that Mastermind would never show up with her mother unit?
She's hidden the mother unit in god-knows-which air raid shelter that you have no hope of finding.
Not to mention, the show I've been looking forward to is finally starting. Please don't interrupt them.
Our forces will be on standby.
Good.
The Key on her...is about to connect with M4A1 again.
Oh, maybe it already has, and we humans just can't tell.
Heheheh...this is getting interesting.
What reaction are you hoping to get from the Key?
I don't really care as long as it's not something I expect.
All I want is for it to be interesting...
You're not concerned about what transpires between M4A1 and Mastermind?
I have no interest in fights until a victor emerges.
Do whatever you want as long as the Plan keeps unfolding...
...And we finally have the Key.
Meanwhile, the AR Team is still trapped in the outpost.
S.F. is still keeping up the bombardment! We're not going to last long!
They could've stormed the place if that's what they wanted, but their objective is to capture me alive...
What's the situation with the Commander?
The Commander just shook off more Sangvis forces and is rushing to our aid.
But we can't wait any longer! We must retreat now!
We need a plan!
Their target is me. Let me be the bait and we can retreat separately!
I will NOT agree to operating separately ever again!
M4, didn't we agree we're gonna stick together from now on?!
But at this rate, none of us will be able to make it out! I can't put you all in danger just because of me!
You're not the only one with a mission here, M4! Our mission is to protect you!
But we're jeopardizing everything – the mission and all of you...
I've already lost AR-15 and M16!
If I have to lose you too, then I'll die with you!
This is the order we all received the moment we left the factory, and I intend to obey it to my very last breath!
Count me in too.
Don't just think about yourself. Our opinions matter too.
I may have only joined the team a few hours ago, but SOP-II and I are very much of one mind.
That's right. Let's all spend this time together. I'll accept any outcome – be it victory or death!
M4A1 lets out a sigh.
We're all idiots, aren't we?
Yeah, what a shame.
Maybe we're meant to die together. That way, no one will be left behind.
Humph. We're only unreliable civilian Dolls, after all.
Wait a second...
What?
RO, if I remember correctly, since you were created with newer technology, your neural cloud can be backed up, right?
Huh? Well...kind of...
But I'm working for Griffin clandestinely, so my neural cloud records are with the Commander. It'll be quite a hassle to download everything again...
Hey! Doesn't that mean you're not gonna die anyway?!
Hmm...probably not...
B-but so what?! You can't exclude me just because of that!
Then that touching moment was a complete waste! Screw off and leave us alone to cry on each other's shoulder!
How could you say that?! That's so mean! Is the AR Team such an exclusive clique?
If you have a problem with that, by all means, exchange your neural cloud for one that can't be backed up!
Pffft...
M4A1 can't help but chuckle.
You're unbelievable. Bickering even under such circumstances.
You're finally smiling. That's the most reassuring sight.
Is...that so?
It kinda ruins your dignity as a team leader, but who cares!
I'd rather have you as a sister by my side right now.
I'm honored...
I'm really sorry about my behavior from before. Too many things have happened, I didn't dare open up to you.
I didn't know how to be who I really am. So many people have said so many different things about this, and I couldn't decide who to believe...
But now, none of that matters.
That's right. I'm no longer afraid of making sacrifices, because they're worth it.
No matter how many deaths I experience, no matter if it's my death or someone else's, rather than worrying about it, it's better to accept it and give it more meaning.
I believe this epiphany is sparked by my own will and my own choice.
What's wrong, M4?
Nothing.
In the end, all I want is to be on the AR Team. Nothing more.
Heh, you're not alone there.
Then let's do our best in the time we have left!
M4A1, RO, and SOP-II embrace each other in laughter.
It's decided then.
Let them come. We're not leaving each other ever again!
Sorry, Captain Yegor, but we simply can't compare to your military units.
Our victories hold meaning only if we charge together, fight together, and experience life and death together.
I must've let you down back then.
If I ever see you again, I hope I can tell you face to face...
That from now on, this is what I live for!
Commander! As you can see, we are being surrounded by Mastermind's forces! This is an emergency!
We are retreating in your direction and desperately in need of your aid!
Please ask your troops to make haste! Have them poke a hole in the Sangvis encirclement so that we can break through!
The AR Team will be waiting for your rescue. We will fight to the end until you get here.
I have faith in you. I know you will definitely come save us... Please, I'm counting on you!
